mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_coupon (user_id, activity_id, coupon_id, status, activate_time, expire_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{activateTime}, #{expireTime}, NOW())
